title: Modulation of Allostery with Multiple Mechanisms by Hotspot Mutations in TetR.
authors: Deng, Jiahua; Yuan, Yuchen; Cui, Qiang
journal: Journal of the American Chemical Society
one_liner_zh: 该文用分子动力学模拟研究TetR转录因子热点突变对别构调控的影响，虽聚焦蛋白别构而非直接DNA结合，但对象为TF-DNA调控体系且方法可迁移至TF-DNA互作机制建模。
abstract: Modulating allosteric coupling offers unique opportunities for biomedical applications. Such efforts can benefit from efficient prediction and evaluation of allostery hotspot residues that dictate the degree of cooperativity between distant sites. We demonstrate that effects of allostery hotspot mutations can be evaluated qualitatively and semiquantitatively by molecular dynamics simulations in a bacterial tetracycline repressor (TetR). The simulations recapitulate the effects of these mutations on abolishing the induction function of TetR and provide a rationale for the different rescuabilities observed to restore allosteric coupling of the hotspot mutations. We demonstrate that the same noninducible phenotype could be the result of perturbations in distinct structural and energetic properties of TetR. Our work underscores the value of explicitly computing the functional free energy landscapes to effectively evaluate and rank hotspot mutations despite the prevalence of compensatory interactions and therefore provides quantitative guidance to allostery modulation for therapeutic and engineering applications.
abstract_zh: 调节别构偶联为生物医学应用提供了独特的机会。此类努力可受益于对决定远距离位点间协同程度的别构热点残基的高效预测与评估。我们证明，通过分子动力学 (molecular dynamics) 模拟，可以定性和半定量地评估细菌四环素阻遏蛋白 (TetR) 中别构热点突变的影响。模拟重现了这些突变消除TetR诱导功能的效果，并为观察到的恢复热点突变别构偶联的不同可拯救性提供了合理解释。我们证明，相同的非诱导表型可能是TetR不同结构和能量特性扰动的结果。我们的工作强调了显式计算功能自由能景观的价值，尽管存在补偿性相互作用的普遍性，仍能有效评估和排序热点突变，从而为治疗和工程应用的别构调节提供定量指导。
